projects.title: Okiemint
projects.cardDescription: A clean, conversion-focused e-commerce build for a modern consumer brand — designed to sell.
projects.summary: A lean e-commerce experience for a modern consumer brand, shaped to feel premium without adding friction to the buying journey.
projects.detailText: The focus was clarity: stronger product presentation, cleaner navigation, and a storefront that keeps attention on conversion.
highlights: Scope: Web design and conversion-focused e-commerce build.
Challenge: Keep the brand polished while making shopping feel simple and immediate.
Outcome: A cleaner path to purchase with a sharper, more sales-ready presentation.

projects.title: Arewa Clinic
projects.cardDescription: A professional healthcare website built to build trust, communicate services, and convert enquiries.
projects.summary: A healthcare website designed to feel calm, credible, and easy to trust from the first interaction.
projects.detailText: We kept the experience straightforward so visitors can understand services quickly and move toward enquiry without confusion.
highlights: Scope: Website design with supporting brand direction.
Challenge: Balance professionalism, warmth, and clarity for a healthcare audience.
Outcome: A more trustworthy digital presence built around service communication and enquiries.

projects.title: Ace Accountants
projects.cardDescription: Brand identity and website for a growing accountancy firm — clear, credible, and built to generate leads.
projects.summary: A brand and website refresh for an accountancy firm that needed to look established, clear, and commercially credible.
projects.detailText: The work centred on simplifying the message and giving the business a more confident visual presence for lead generation.
highlights: Scope: Brand identity and lead-focused website design.
Challenge: Make a growing firm feel both approachable and authoritative.
Outcome: A clearer positioning system with a cleaner client acquisition experience.

projects.title: Office Fitout Co.
projects.cardDescription: A bold, project-led website for a commercial interior fit-out business, showcasing their portfolio with impact.
projects.summary: A portfolio-led site for a commercial interiors company that needed stronger project presentation and more visual impact.
projects.detailText: The design was structured to let the work speak first, while still making the business feel organised and conversion-aware.
highlights: Challenge: Showcase large visual work without making the experience feel heavy.
Outcome: A bolder, cleaner portfolio presence built to support credibility and enquiries.

projects.title: Seedrock Consulting
projects.cardDescription: Strategy consultancy brand and website — positioned for credibility and designed to attract high-value clients.
projects.summary: A consultancy brand and website positioned to feel strategic, composed, and credible to higher-value clients.
projects.detailText: The output focused on sharpening the firm’s presentation so the business reads clearly and confidently at first glance.
highlights: Scope: Brand direction and website design.
Challenge: Communicate expertise without relying on dense or overly corporate messaging.
Outcome: A more refined digital presence that supports premium positioning.
